method.patchIdentity: git cherry <head> <branch> (a + line is a non-patch-equivalent commit)
method.contentCheck: git diff --quiet <branch> <head> -- <files touched by the branch unique commits>
method.prIdentity: gh pr list --state all; mergeCommit ancestry checked with git merge-base --is-ancestor
method.limitation: Squash merges change patch context, so git cherry reports source commits as non-equivalent even when their content is integrated. Each divergent branch was therefore checked for its PR merge commit in HEAD and for identical file content where the touched set was small.
